title: CSS for Beginners

category.name: Web Development
category.description: Build websites with HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

short_description: Style web pages with colours, fonts, spacing, Flexbox and Grid, and make them work on phones.
description: CSS turns plain HTML into a designed page. In this course you learn selectors, colours and fonts, the box model, Flexbox and Grid layouts, and responsive design with media queries. Every example is a live editor, so you can change a value and see the page update.
